caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large title names a people-generated-content engine; the main concept spans the line inside a broad multicolour gradient band and a small acronym badge points back to it.
visual_anatomy.layout: One brand-input bar at the top routes down into three parallel audience or contributor cards, then all three arrows converge into a bottom brand-benefit bar with five closing outcome tiles.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → shared brand inputs → compare the three contributor cards across ideal voices, investment, and deployment → follow the arrows into the joined bottom outcome strip.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans headline, bold all-caps band titles, bold micro-headings inside white content cards, and short bulleted supporting copy.
visual_anatomy.colour: A magenta top and bottom band frames warm peach, green, and blue contributor columns; the headline uses a separate orange-to-aqua gradient.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, thin grey or purple rules, rounded rectangular containers, repeated white inset cards, funnel illustrations, downward arrows, and soft shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: One shared input system, three actor-specific implementation columns, and a joined five-part brand outcome strip.
visual_anatomy.density: High but coherent: shared inputs and shared output bracket a three-way comparison, so the reader can identify what changes by contributor type.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled intermediate state applies distinct colours to the three contributor cards and reveals their inset content and funnel diagrams through horizontal masks; the final state restores the full top-to-bottom flow with all arrows and outcome tiles visible.
motion.motion_job: Assemble a shared-input, parallel-actor, shared-output model in its dependency order so the reader sees the system before reading its dense copy.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare how one common strategy needs to change for distinct actor groups while still seeing the system-level result.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Shared-input to parallel pathways to shared-output flow.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Bracket a limited set of differentiated paths between the inputs every path shares and the result their contributions jointly enable.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when upstream inputs and downstream outcomes are genuinely shared; otherwise label independent systems separately instead of implying a flywheel.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the people-generated-content model, actor categories, brand-benefit claims, top-and-bottom band flow, funnel illustrations, gradient headline, panel colours, or reveal choreography.

claim_boundary.note: The visual makes commercial and workflow claims about contributor groups and a brand flywheel. They are not independently validated by the supplied corpus.
